items.name: 2026 real estate and service center expansion program
items.claim: Old Dominion's aggregate 2026 capital expenditure plan of approximately $380 million includes $180 million earmarked for real estate and service center expansion projects.
items.source_excerpt: The Company expects its aggregate capital expenditures for 2026 to total approximately $380 million. This total now includes planned expenditures of $180 million for real estate and service center expansion projects; $155 million for tractors and trailers; and $45 million for information technology and other assets.

notes: Q2 2026 8-K earnings release (EX-99.1) is the only stored evidence for Old Dominion. It discloses a dollar-specific 2026 capex allocation for service-center network expansion, which is the direct-exposure link (diesel-demand-anchor) evidence this pipeline records. No named individual project sites or contract awards are disclosed at this level of the release.
